notes.title: Dynamic Game Update!
notes.notes:
Slide Kick Now you can make a Slide Kick on the ground while you running, slide kick is a very powerful ability and it consumes energy, play the tutorial section to learn how to do it.
Run mechanic has been implemented as well!
Energy bar - affecting Run mechanic and Slide Kick, Please play the Tutorial section of the game to learn a little bit more about new mechanics!
Bug fixes - many bugs have been fixed, so the gameplay process now going smooth and better!
Enemy AI - Hulk's become a little bit smarter, and also stopped attacking when getting hurt!
Slow Mo - Now whenever an enemy or Player registers a physical hit, time in the game freezes for 0.1sec to make the gameplay process a little bit clear so you can see whose got hurt and also gives you a short time frame to think about your next step.

So enjoy this Update!
Thank you for Playing Dictator's Creed!
